title: conyza vernonioides
intro: Conyza vernonioides, commonly known as Horseweed, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Conyza vernonioides include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antiseptic effects.
